name: Intersection of Guild St. & River St.
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. The city wall is to the north, towering over
desc3: twenty feet above you. River street is fairly quiet, but is well-used
desc4: as it intersects many main streets. It continues to the east and west.
desc5: The broad expanse of Guild street goes off to the south here, heading
desc6: towards, and ending in, the town square. You can make out the entrance
desc7: to a low wooden building off to the south.
